kiosk.actions.en:
- Click the main part of the control, or press **⌘O**, to move the page into the Space shown in the toolbar.
- Click the arrow, or press **⌘⇧O**, to open the menu and choose another Space.

These are the default shortcuts. To change them, open **Settings → Shortcuts → Kiosk & Peek** and look for **Open Kiosk or Peek in current Space** and **Show Kiosk "Open in" Menu**.
kiosk.actions.desc: Replace the three bullets below the Open in [Space] toolbar description with two bullets and a shortcut customization paragraph. Explain toolbar target, not URL Rule priority. Preserve the existing introduction and the paragraph about reloading.

peek.shortcut.en: Press **⌘O** to use **Open as Tab** and move the preview into your current Space. To change this shortcut, open **Settings → Shortcuts → Kiosk & Peek** and edit **Open Kiosk or Peek in current Space**. Kiosk uses the same shortcut setting.
peek.shortcut.desc: New paragraph after the panel controls table and before Close a Peek. Open as Tab shortcut shares Kiosk customization. Do not add a statement about Cmd+Shift+O being Kiosk-only.

tips.rows.en:
| Open a Kiosk page or Peek as a tab in a Space | Command (⌘) + O |
| Open the Kiosk Space selection menu | Command (⌘) + Shift (⇧) + O |
tips.rows.desc: Append two rows to the existing shortcut table; preserve Markdown pipes and existing modifier key naming in this locale.

tips.settings.en: Change the two Open in Space shortcuts under **Settings → Shortcuts → Kiosk & Peek**. See [Kiosk](/kiosk/) and [Peek View](/peek/) for details.
tips.settings.desc: Replace the prior Change these two shortcuts paragraph. Explicitly identify the two Open in Space shortcuts because the new global shortcut row now precedes them. Preserve links and the Kiosk & Peek settings path.

settings.path.desc: Replace only the old Settings → General path on tips (auto Picture-in-Picture), phi-browser-skill (Developer mode), agent-passwords (Developer mode). Use existing locale Settings wording and shipped Advanced label. Do not change themes.

privacy.path.desc: Replace only Settings → Additional Browser Settings prefix in account deletion paragraph; keep every other privacy statement unchanged. Use current product labels.

kiosk.global.en:
## Open Kiosk from any app

Press **⌘⌥N** to open a new Kiosk window. To use this shortcut while another app is active, open **Settings → Navigation → Kiosk** and turn on **Open Kiosk when pressing ⌘⌥N in any app**.

To change the key combination, open **Settings → Shortcuts**, find **New Kiosk Window** under **File**, and set your preferred shortcut. The Navigation switch displays the shortcut you choose.
kiosk.global.desc: New section between the paragraph about inherited Profiles and the URL Rules heading. Explain default shortcut, Navigation enable switch, and customization under Shortcuts File. Preserve heading structure and add explicit {#open-kiosk-from-any-app} on the translated heading. Shipped switch template %@ must be replaced with ⌘⌥N.

tips.globalRow.en: | Open a new Kiosk window from any app, with the global shortcut enabled | Command (⌘) + Option (⌥) + N |
tips.globalRow.desc: New shortcut table row immediately BEFORE the two Open in Space shortcut rows. Keep two columns and use existing locale Command/Option key terminology.

tips.globalSettings.en: Enable the global Kiosk shortcut under **Settings → Navigation → Kiosk**. To change its keys, edit **New Kiosk Window** under **Settings → Shortcuts → File**.
tips.globalSettings.desc: New paragraph immediately after the shortcut table and before the existing paragraph about two Open in Space shortcuts. Distinguish Navigation enable switch from File New Kiosk Window custom binding.
